content:
Jin Park: quick heads-up — we need to consolidate some SKUs in eu-west to free up capacity for the Acme demo next Wed. planning to collapse `h100-32g` and `h100-64g-sparse` into a single pool for 72h window.
Priya Shah: can you say how many effective slots that buys us?
Jin Park: rough calc: collapsing those frees ~6 h100-equivalent slots (or ~12 a100-equivalent). depends on packing; I put numbers in the doc.
Carlos Mendez: @Jin any billing tag changes? last time invoices got mis-tagged when we moved pools. need `project:acme-demo` on reserved instances.
Jin Park: yes — I'll add `billing_tag=acme-demo` to the terraform change. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1287
Sam Li: pinging infra-ops — any objections to short-lived pool name changes? we need the slots by Mon EOD to run dry-run.
OncallBot: INF-ALLOC: current eu-west pool utilization 87%. Available burst capacity: 2 h100 slots. Reservation conflict detected with tenant `internal-core` for window 1716880000-1716900000.
Priya Shah: thanks @OncallBot — that's why we need the consolidation. can we get a temporary preemption policy so internal-core yields during demo window?
Carlos Mendez: internal-core owner is @Sam Li — Sam, can you confirm if they can shift?
Sam Li: internal-core can drop 2 slots for the window but not more. I can coordinate with their PM.
VendorOps: APAC racks ETA updated — eu-west additional racks currently estimate 9 business days for procurement and crossdock. If you need faster, we can try a short-term borrow from partner pool (fees apply).
Jin Park: borrowing would be last resort — prefer consolidation + preemption. I'll update PR with `preemption_policy = "demo-priority"` and add an explicit `billing_tag`.
Priya Shah: also add a note in the rollout doc to run `terraform plan` and check `module.gpu_pool` changes; last time drift caused a recreate.
Jin Park: good call — added a small code snippet in PR description: ```terraform plan -var='billing_tag=acme-demo' | grep module.gpu_pool```
Carlos Mendez: quick QA: will existing KV-cache-backed pods be evicted? we need sticky KV for long-running perf tests.
Jin Park: I'll set `sticky_kvcache = true` for pods with label `demo=true` during the window so we don't warm cold cache mid-demo.
Sam Li: confirmed with internal-core PM — they accept preemption for 2 slots. I'll post a schedule in their channel.
Priya Shah: perfect. Jin please include rollback steps in the PR description — `terraform apply` rollback plan + how to re-expand pools.
Jin Park: will do. ETA for PR review? hoping for a quick pass today so we can land Fri morning.
Carlos Mendez: i'll take the review after lunch.
VendorOps: FYI billing ops flagged that `billing_tag` must match invoice code `ACME-2026` or it will route to misc bucket. please include that exact string.
Jin Park: noted — will set `billing_tag=ACME-2026`.
OncallBot: NOTE: maintenance window scheduled for 1716810000-1716813600 in eu-west; possible short eviction of preemptible instances. Please avoid landing changes during that window.
Priya Shah: ok adjust timeline — aim to merge before the maintenance window.
Sam Li: I can shift internal-core's drop window earlier to avoid overlap.
Carlos Mendez: thumbs up :thumbsup: let's keep communications in this thread for the next few hours.
Jin Park: thanks all — will update the PR and ping again when ready for review.
